scope: Original Factory PegInsert actor path; no PPO optimizer, reward, physics, success predicate, or checkpoint mutation

checkpoint_policy.loading: Select explicit allowlisted role; verify file SHA-256 before trusted local torch.load(map_location=cpu, weights_only=False); verify epoch/frame, exact model key set, tensor shapes/dtypes/finiteness; strict load_state_dict; model.eval; move frozen RMS/model/state together to chosen policy device. Never silently substitute checkpoint or RMS.
checkpoint_policy.rms_values_evidence: checkpoint_audit.json#/checkpoints/<role>/rms (all 19 float64 mean/variance entries and scalar count)

input.device: Runtime input is contiguous float32 Tensor[B,19] on same device as actor and h/c; RMS stored float64 on that device. CPU is used only for audit/mocks in I0. Sim-to-policy device transfer is explicit via wrapper clone. No implicit batching/broadcasting.

ordering.name: fingertip_pos_rel_fixed
ordering.meaning: p_fingertip - (fixed_pos_obs_frame + init_fixed_pos_obs_noise); subtract the noise, not add it
ordering.frame: world axes; subtraction reference is not a rotating local frame
ordering.update: one returned observation after each env.step; source value updated during each physics step
ordering.scaling: No feature-specific pre-scale; concatenate physical values then frozen RMS float32 transform, clamp [-5,5]
ordering.privileged_dependency: fixed_pos_obs_frame is tf_combine(simulator fixed_quat,fixed_pos,local tip offset) at reset, not an external perception measurement; fingertip position is simulator body pose minus env_origins

ordering.name: fingertip_quat
ordering.frame: World axes, raw body_quat_w of panda_fingertip_centered, wxyz; no sign canonicalization
ordering.update: one returned observation after each env.step
ordering.scaling: No feature-specific pre-scale; concatenate physical values then frozen RMS float32 transform, clamp [-5,5]

ordering.name: ee_linvel
ordering.meaning: finite difference of fingertip midpoint position
ordering.update: finite difference uses one physics dt (1/120 s); value is returned at policy-step boundary
ordering.scaling: No feature-specific pre-scale; concatenate physical values then frozen RMS float32 transform, clamp [-5,5]

ordering.name: ee_angvel
ordering.meaning: quaternion difference converted to axis-angle and divided by physics dt
ordering.update: finite difference uses one physics dt (1/120 s); value is returned at policy-step boundary
ordering.scaling: No feature-specific pre-scale; concatenate physical values then frozen RMS float32 transform, clamp [-5,5]

ordering.name: prev_actions
ordering.meaning: Factory self.actions cache after EMA; initial reset cache derived from pose, not all zeros; not the previous raw mu
ordering.update: updated at policy step by EMA before eight physics substeps; reset initializes it from the initial pose
ordering.scaling: No feature-specific pre-scale; concatenate physical values then frozen RMS float32 transform, clamp [-5,5]

input.critic_boundary: The asymmetric critic receives 43 dimensions in the actual default state_order plus prev_actions. It is privileged training input and is not part of this actor deployment contract. The config class placeholder state_space=72 is overwritten by runtime concatenation; do not pass critic state to the actor.
input.critic_velocity: Critic uses simulator body velocities; actor uses physics-step finite differences. Critic joint/held/fixed poses are privileged. Actor also indirectly depends on simulator fixed-pose truth through relative position.

normalization.values: checkpoint_audit.json: per-checkpoint rms contains complete arrays, count and config SHA
normalization.freeze: model.eval() required: no_grad/inference_mode alone does not stop RMS statistics updating in training mode; never update or write checkpoint buffers
normalization.wrapper_clip_observations: math.inf (no finite pre-RMS clipping) from evaluator:122; distinct from normalized [-5,5]
normalization.invalid_metadata: Reject missing/nonfloat64/wrong rank/wrong size/nonfinite mean or variance, negative variance, nonscalar/nonpositive/nonfinite count, changed epsilon or clip; never replace with identity
normalization.cpu_evidence: All three actual checkpoint RMS compared to installed official RunningMeanStd on same FP32 synthetic input: exact equality and buffers unchanged; no actor forward was run

policy_lstm.architecture: continuous_a2c_logstd / actor_critic, separate=false; 19 -> torch.nn.LSTM(input19,hidden1024,layers2,dropout0) -> LayerNorm(1024,eps=1e-5) -> Linear512/ELU -> Linear128/ELU -> Linear64/ELU -> mu Linear6 (identity). Separate state-dependent logstd Linear6, exp(logstd); value Linear1 unused for deterministic actor. Asymmetric 43D central critic not required.

state.reset: zero hidden and cell columns for every completed episode before next episode action
state.dtype_device: hidden/cell float32 on policy device; preserve batch identity, [2,B,1024], independent of training env count
state.checkpoint: No runtime hidden/cell state restored from checkpoint; env_state is null in all three reviewed files

policy_lstm.mode: model.eval + inference_mode; is_train=False; choose mus not Normal.sample output; no AMP in the initial FP32 parity contract
policy_lstm.raw_output: mu_activation=None, so the raw mean is not intrinsically bounded
policy_lstm.concat_input: Configuration true, but inactive when before_mlp=true; actual first MLP weight is [512,1024], no 19D input concatenation
policy_lstm.rng: Official model creates a Normal sample even when Player later selects mu; RNG advances. A mean-only implementation must explicitly preserve this RNG effect or register/reset independent RNG and report that episode seeds no longer imply identical reset streams. I0 does not claim full rollout parity.
policy_lstm.training: Training rollout samples Normal(mu,exp(logstd)); optimization is_train=True evaluates prev_actions logprob/entropy. Saved player deterministic=false is overridden by independent evaluator to policy_mean; training AMP flag does not authorize AMP inference.

postprocessing: Player selects mu, clamps [-1,1], affine-rescales Box[-1,1] (identity here); wrapper separately clips [-1,1] and clones to simulation device
Factory cache a = 0.2*incoming_clipped + 0.8*previous_cache once per policy step; NO additional cache clamp
Every physics substep: target_pos = current_fingertip_pos + a[:3]*[0.02,0.02,0.02] m; clamp target_pos-fixed_pos_action_frame using bounds [-0.05,+0.05] per axis
rotvec=a[3:]*[0.097,0.097,0.097] rad; angle=norm(rotvec); delta_quat=quat_from_angle_axis, identity if angle<=1e-6; q_target=delta_quat*q_current (left multiplication)
q_target -> Euler xyz; roll literal3.14159, pitch0, retain computed yaw; Euler -> final quaternion. Rotation bounds[1,1,1] are configured but unused in this path. PegInsert unidirectional_rot=false
Gripper target0.0; task-space PD wrench=Kp*pose_error-Kd*FD_velocity; arm torque=J^T*wrench+mass-matrix dynamically consistent null-space posture term; software torque clamp[-100,100]

Arm joint position PD gains are zero; set_joint_effort_target supplies seven arm torques. PhysX arm effort limits87N*m joints1-4,12N*m joints5-7; fingers position target0, stiffness7500,damping173,effort_limit40; requested torques do not prove actual contact forces
action.safety: Reject non-finite raw/normalized/action values and shape mismatch. Record per-dimension clipping/saturation in G4-I1; no-command/deadline behavior is not claimed by I0.

controller.not_policy_input: Low-level controller additionally needs joint pos/vel, averaged left/right finger Jacobian and 7x7 arm mass matrix from simulator; these are unavailable from actor observation alone

reset_cache.yaw: left multiply quat_from_euler(-pi,0,0) by current quat; get yaw; if yaw>pi/2 subtract2pi; if yaw<-pi add2pi; cache_z=((yaw+pi)/(3*pi/2))*2-1
reset_cache.velocity: actor finite-difference linear and angular buffers zeroed
reset_cache.warning: Cache is not guaranteed bounded [-1,1]; h/c zero and cache reset are different operations

timing.action_holding: same smoothed action is applied in each of eight _apply_action calls during one env.step; target/controller signals are regenerated in the physics loop
timing.episode: Nominal episode_length_s=10; max_episode_length=ceil(10/(8/120))=150; counter increments then timeout>=149, hence149 policy steps=9.9333333333 simulated seconds before auto-reset. Both terminated and truncated true at timeout. Success has no early termination. Reset/grasp/IK advances extra physics outside this episode counter.
timing.wall_clock: Unmeasured in I0. 15Hz is simulated cadence, not wall-clock throughput or latency. I1 records episode wall time; synchronized latency distributions/deadline behavior belong to I2.
timing.rnn_reset: env.step computes pre-reset success/reward, auto-resets and returns new observation; evaluator then zeros h/c columns for done actors before next get_action. Source evaluate_checkpoint.py:244-274 and evaluation_runtime.py:18-27.

standalone_pseudocode: select explicitly G2 primary; verify allowlisted SHA before trusted deserialize; strict check model/RMS config and shapes
model.eval(); h,c=zeros([2,B,1024],fp32,policy_device); env.reset(); cache comes from reset pose
receive obs[B,19] fp32; verify finiteness, ordering, batch/device and frozen RMS metadata
choose mu; account for official discarded Normal sample RNG effect if reproducing reset random stream
a=clamp(mu,-1,1); wrapper clips and copies to sim device; cache=.2*a+.8*cache (no reclip)
for each of8physics steps: read current pose/FD vel; regenerate position and upright quaternion targets; PD/J^T/nullspace -> arm effort and closed finger position
check done/reward/pre-reset success; environment auto-resets before returning observation
if done: zero h1,c1 done columns BEFORE next action; use new pose-derived cache and zero FD velocities, not zero cache

on nonfinite/shape/identity mismatch: raise, submit no new command, record original error and exit nonzero; I1 must mock-test this boundary. Timeout/no-command recovery is preregistered for I2, not claimed implemented by I0
